moral_character_required.quote: An applicant may not be licensed unless the board finds that the applicant is qualified and no cause exists, as set forth in section 3282‑A, that may be considered grounds for disciplinary action against a licensed physician or surgeon.

required.quote: Each applicant who has graduated from an accredited medical school on or after July 1, 2004 or an unaccredited medical school must have satisfactorily completed at least 36 months in a graduate educational program accredited by the Accreditation Council on Graduate Medical Education

experience_source.quote: Each applicant who has graduated from an accredited medical school on or after July 1, 2004 or an unaccredited medical school must have satisfactorily completed at least 36 months in a graduate educational program accredited by the Accreditation Council on Graduate Medical Education

duration.value: 36 months (for graduates on or after July 1, 2004); 24 months (for graduates Jan 1, 1970 – June 30, 2004); 12 months (for graduates before Jan 1, 1970)
duration.quote: Each applicant who has graduated from an accredited medical school on or after July 1, 2004 or an unaccredited medical school must have satisfactorily completed at least 36 months in a graduate educational program

exams.name: Federation of State Medical Boards uniform examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Applicant must achieve a passing score on each component of the uniform examination of the Federation of State Medical Boards or other examinations designated by the board.
exams.quote: Each applicant must achieve a passing score on each component of the uniform examination of the Federation of State Medical Boards or other examinations designated by the board as the qualifying examination or examinations for licensure.

exams.name: State of Maine examination
exams.notes: In addition to the USMLE, applicants must pass a State of Maine examination administered by the board.
exams.quote: Each applicant must additionally achieve a passing score on a State of Maine examination administered by the board.

interval_years.quote: the board shall provide to every physician whose application is approved and accepted a proof of license renewal that is valid for no longer than 2 years

required.quote: every licensee seeking renewal of a license with the intent of conducting active medical practice in this State shall submit evidence, satisfactory to the board, of successful completion of a course of continuing medical education within the preceding 24 months, as prescribed by rule.

period_years.quote: successful completion of a course of continuing medical education within the preceding 24 months

value: opioid prescribing (3 hours every 2 years for those who prescribe opioids)
topical_requirements.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter must successfully complete 3 hours of continuing education every 2 years on the prescription of opioid medication as a condition of prescribing opioid medication.

available.quote: The board may, at its discretion, grant licensure without written examination to a physician in good standing who otherwise meets the requirements of section 3271

requirements.value: Board may grant licensure without written examination to a physician in good standing who meets the requirements of §3271 and has been examined and certified by the National Board of Medical Examiners, examined and licensed by another state with an equivalent examination, or holds specified Canadian/British Isles credentials. Fee not more than $600.
requirements.quote: The board may, at its discretion, grant licensure without written examination to a physician in good standing who otherwise meets the requirements of section 3271

exists.quote: The Board of Licensure in Medicine, as established by Title 5, section 12004‑A, subsection 24, and in this chapter called the "board," consists of 11 individuals who are residents of this State, appointed by the Governor.

national_certification.quote: Examined and certified by the National Board of Medical Examiners

national_association.value: Accreditation Council on Graduate Medical Education (ACGME); American Board of Medical Specialties
national_association.quote: Notwithstanding this subsection, an applicant who is board certified by the American Board of Medical Specialties is deemed to meet the postgraduate training requirements of this subsection.

regulatory_model.quote: Unless licensed by the board, an individual may not practice medicine or surgery or a branch of medicine or surgery

credential_type.quote: Unless licensed by the board, an individual may not practice medicine or surgery or a branch of medicine or surgery

is_mandatory.quote: Unless licensed by the board, an individual may not practice medicine or surgery or a branch of medicine or surgery

title_protection.quote: Whoever, not being duly licensed by the board, practices medicine or surgery or a branch of medicine or surgery, or purports to practice medicine or surgery or a branch of medicine or surgery in a way cited in this section, or who uses the title "Doctor" or the letters "Dr." or the letters "M.D." in connection with that individual's name, contrary to this section, commits a Class E crime.

scope_protection.quote: Unless licensed by the board, an individual may not practice medicine or surgery or a branch of medicine or surgery

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in obtaining a license or in connection with services rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining a license under this chapter or in connection with service rendered within the scope of the license issued

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misuse of alcohol, drugs, or other substances that has resulted or may result in endangering the health or safety of patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misuse of alcohol, drugs or other substances that has resulted or may result in the licensee performing services in a manner that endangers the health or safety of patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: A professional diagnosis of a mental or physical condition that has resulted or may result in performing services in a manner that endangers patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A professional diagnosis of a mental or physical condition that has resulted or may result in the licensee performing services in a manner that endangers the health or safety of patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by an unlicensed individual who claims to be legally licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by an individual who is not licensed under this chapter and who claims to be legally licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice for which the licensee is licensed, including lack of ability, fitness, knowledge, or inability to apply principles or skills
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence in the practice for which the licensee is licensed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct including violation of professional standards or engaging in disruptive behavior that interferes with delivery of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct. A licensee is considered to have engaged in unprofessional conduct if the licensee violates a standard of professional behavior, including engaging in disruptive behavior

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime involving dishonesty or false statement, that relates to the practice, or for which incarceration for one year or more may be imposed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a crime that involves dishonesty or false statement or relates directly to the practice for which the licensee is licensed, or conviction of a crime for which incarceration for one year or more may be imposed

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation of the practice act chapter or a rule adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of this chapter or a rule adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in false, misleading, or deceptive advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in false, misleading or deceptive advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing narcotic, hypnotic, or controlled substance drugs for other than accepted therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing narcotic or hypnotic or other drugs listed as controlled substances by the Drug Enforcement Administration for other than accepted therapeutic purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report an impaired physician to the board secretary as required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report to the secretary of the board a physician licensed under this chapter for addiction to alcohol or drugs or for mental illness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, restriction, denial, or surrender of a license in another state or jurisdiction for conduct that would constitute grounds for discipline in Maine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension or restriction of a license to practice medicine or other disciplinary action; denial of an application for a license; or surrender of a license to practice medicine following the institution of disciplinary action by another state or a territory

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in activity requiring a license beyond the scope of the license held
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any activity requiring a license under the governing law of the board that is beyond the scope of acts authorized by the license held

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continuing to practice after expiration, suspension, or revocation of the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continuing to act in a capacity requiring a license under the governing law of the board after expiration, suspension or revocation of that license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Noncompliance with a board order or consent agreement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Noncompliance with an order or consent agreement of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to produce documents in the licensee's possession concerning a pending complaint or investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to produce upon request of the board any documents in the licensee's possession or under the licensee's control concerning a pending complaint or proceeding or any matter under investigation by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to timely respond to a complaint notification sent by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to timely respond to a complaint notification sent by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the prohibition on advertising, offering, or administering conversion therapy to a minor

definition_quote.value: diagnosing, relieving in any degree or curing, or professing or attempting to diagnose, relieve or cure a human disease, ailment, defect or complaint, whether physical or mental, or of physical and mental origin, by attendance or by advice, or by prescribing or furnishing a drug, medicine, appliance, manipulation, method or a therapeutic agent whatsoever
definition_quote.quote: diagnosing, relieving in any degree or curing, or professing or attempting to diagnose, relieve or cure a human disease, ailment, defect or complaint, whether physical or mental, or of physical and mental origin, by attendance or by advice, or by prescribing or furnishing a drug, medicine, appliance, manipulation, method or a therapeutic agent whatsoever

methods_authorized.quote: by attendance or by advice, or by prescribing or furnishing a drug, medicine, appliance, manipulation, method or a therapeutic agent whatsoever

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe, administer, and dispense drugs including controlled substances within accepted therapeutic purposes; opioid prescribing is subject to statutory limits (100 MME/day cap with exceptions for cancer, palliative care, end-of-life, MAT, and certain facility settings).
drug_authority.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter and whose scope of practice includes prescribing opioid medication may not prescribe: A. To a patient any combination of opioid medication in an aggregate amount in excess of 100 morphine milligram equivalents of opioid medication per day

license_status_types.quote: The board may issue a license limited to the practice of administrative medicine, or any other special license, as defined by routine technical rule of the board

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Graduates of unaccredited foreign medical schools must be evaluated by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates and receive a permanent ECFMG certificate, OR achieve a passing score on the Visa Qualifying Examination or a substantially equivalent examination. They must also complete at least 36 months of ACGME-accredited postgraduate training. A waiver is available for foreign graduates licensed elsewhere with at least 3 years clinical experience who meet additional criteria.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Graduate from an unaccredited medical school, be evaluated by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates and receive a permanent certificate from the Educational Commission for Foreign Graduates

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Each applicant who has graduated from an accredited medical school on or after July 1, 2004 or an unaccredited medical school must have satisfactorily completed at least 36 months in a graduate educational program accredited by the Accreditation Council on Graduate Medical Education

pain_management_education_required.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter must successfully complete 3 hours of continuing education every 2 years on the prescription of opioid medication as a condition of prescribing opioid medication.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Licensees whose scope includes prescribing opioids may not prescribe more than 100 MME/day; for patients with active prescriptions above 100 MME/day at the time the section took effect, prescriptions may not exceed 300 MME/day (capped at 100 MME/day on or after July 1, 2017); no more than 30-day supply for chronic pain within a 30-day period (effective Jan 1, 2017); no more than 7-day supply for acute pain within a 7-day period (effective Jan 1, 2017). Exceptions for cancer, palliative care, end-of-life, MAT, and certain inpatient/surgical settings.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter and whose scope of practice includes prescribing opioid medication may not prescribe: A. To a patient any combination of opioid medication in an aggregate amount in excess of 100 morphine milligram equivalents of opioid medication per day

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A physician licensed in Maine may provide telehealth services including prescribing within their scope of practice and in accordance with standards of practice and board rules. Out-of-state physicians may provide only consultative telehealth services (no independent prescribing to Maine patients) and must be registered with the board; the Maine-licensed physician retains ultimate authority over diagnosis, care, and treatment.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A person licensed under this chapter may provide telehealth services as long as the licensee acts within the scope of practice of the licensee's license, in accordance with any requirements and restrictions imposed by this subchapter and in accordance with standards of practice.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: The board may register a physician to practice medicine in this State through interstate telehealth if the following conditions are met

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The board shall request a background check for an individual licensed under this chapter who applies for an expedited license under section 18506.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician assistant with less than 4,000 hours of clinical practice documented to the board shall work in accordance with a collaborative agreement with an active physician that describes the physician assistant's scope of practice

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician associates/assistants may dispense prescription and legend drugs (including schedule II-V controlled substances) only when a pharmacy service is not reasonably available, dispensing is in the patient's best interest, or an emergency exists; distributing professional samples is permitted without restriction.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: a physician associate who dispenses a prescription or legend drug: A. Shall comply with all relevant federal and state laws and federal regulations and state rules; and B. May dispense the prescription or legend drug only when: (1) A pharmacy service is not reasonably available; (2) Dispensing the drug is in the best interests of the patient; or (3) An emergency exists.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The board may establish protocols for the operation of a professional review committee as defined in Title 24, section 2502, subsection 4‑A. The protocols may not prohibit an impaired physician or physician associate from seeking alternative forms of treatment.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the board may compel a physician to submit to a mental or physical examination by a physician or another person designated by the board.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The board may issue a license limited to the practice of administrative medicine, or any other special license, as defined by routine technical rule of the board

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A physician who is qualified under section 3275 may, without examination, be granted a temporary license for a period not to exceed one year when the board determines that this action is necessary in order to provide relief for local or national emergencies or for situations in which the number of physicians is insufficient to supply adequate medical services or for the purpose of permitting the physician to serve as locum tenens for another physician who is licensed to practice medicine in this State.
